scenarios.title: A｜向老师请假
scenarios.setting: 玩家知道自己下周无法来上课，于是提前告诉老师。

turns.text: Professor Miller, could I talk to you about next week’s class?

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己担心的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it to class next Tuesday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it to class next Tuesday.
feedback.explanation: “won't be able to make it”在约时间的语境中表示无法到场或能否赴约，不是字面的“制作”。

choices.text: I need to miss class next Tuesday. Is there anything I should do?

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to miss class next Tuesday. Is there anything I should do?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I have an appointment that I can’t reschedule, so I won’t be able to attend.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have an appointment that I can’t reschedule, so I won’t be able to attend.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Would it be okay if I missed class next Tuesday?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be okay if I missed class next Tuesday?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I want to ask for a leave next Tuesday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m afraid I won’t be able to make it to class next Tuesday.
feedback.explanation: 这里的“leave”指请假，通常不加“a”；课堂缺席可直接说明“I won’t be able to attend class”。

turns.text: That’s fine. Just make sure you catch up on what you miss.

turns.prompt: 你想确认请假后可以怎样跟上课程，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. Is there anything I should read or prepare?

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Is there anything I should read or prepare?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Will the class materials be posted online?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will the class materials be posted online?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Is there anything due that day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything due that day?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Should I ask a classmate for the notes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I ask a classmate for the notes?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

turns.text: I’ll upload the slides afterward. There’s also an assignment I’ll explain in class.

turns.prompt: 关于「缺课与请假」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I’ll check the slides and ask a classmate about the assignment.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll check the slides and ask a classmate about the assignment.
feedback.explanation: “assignment”指布置的任务，是可数名词。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜向同学借笔记
scenarios.setting: 玩家缺了一节课，第二天遇到同学。

turns.text: Hey, I missed class yesterday. Could I ask you a favor?

turns.prompt: 你想向同学借看缺课期间的笔记，会怎么说？

choices.text: Would you mind sharing your notes with me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you mind sharing your notes with me?
feedback.explanation: “Would you mind + 动词 -ing”礼貌请求对方做事，给对方表达不便的余地。

choices.text: Could I take a look at your notes from yesterday’s class?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I take a look at your notes from yesterday’s class?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Could you send me a photo of your notes when you have time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me a photo of your notes when you have time?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I was wondering if I could borrow your notes for a little while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was wondering if I could borrow your notes for a little while.
feedback.explanation: 用过去式开头缓和请求，表达试探或期待，而不是要求对方必须照办。

choices.text: Can you borrow me your notes?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you mind sharing your notes with me?
feedback.explanation: 别人借出笔记用“lend”，自己借入用“borrow”；请求分享笔记也可用“share your notes”。

turns.text: Sure. I can send them to you later today.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That would be great. Thanks!

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be great. Thanks!
feedback.explanation: “would be great”把选择说成自己乐于接受的安排，比命令对方照办更柔和。

choices.text: I really appreciate it. No rush.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really appreciate it. No rush.
feedback.explanation: “no rush”表示不着急，能让对方知道时间安排可以从容一些。

choices.text: Thanks. I just want to make sure I didn’t miss anything important.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I just want to make sure I didn’t miss anything important.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.text: No problem. The professor also posted the slides online.

turns.prompt: 关于「缺课与请假」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, perfect. I’ll check those too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, perfect. I’ll check those too.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. I’ll compare them with your notes. Thanks again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll compare them with your notes. Thanks again.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜询问错过的内容
scenarios.setting: 在“缺课与请假”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“询问错过的内容”。

turns.text: Hey, what did I miss in class yesterday?
We finished Chapter 5 and started talking about the final project.

turns.prompt: 你想了解缺课期间是否有新的作业或重要内容，会怎么说？

choices.text: Did the professor give us any new assignments?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did the professor give us any new assignments?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Was there anything important that wasn’t in the slides?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was there anything important that wasn’t in the slides?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Did she explain anything about the final project?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did she explain anything about the final project?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to catch up on before the next class?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to catch up on before the next class?
feedback.explanation: “catch up on”表示补上落下的内容，适合缺课或缺席后问需要补做什么。

choices.text: What important things did I lose?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did the professor give us any new assignments?
feedback.explanation: 错过课堂内容用“miss”，不是“lose”；可问“What did I miss?”，再确认作业等具体信息。

turns.text: Yeah. We have to choose our project topics by Friday.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认自己错过的任务要求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, I didn’t know that. How do we submit our topics?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I didn’t know that. How do we submit our topics?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Did she say what kind of topics we can choose?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did she say what kind of topics we can choose?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Is it an individual project or a group project?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it an individual project or a group project?
feedback.explanation: 把两种可能列出来请对方确认，适合核对自己拿不准的细节。

turns.text: It’s individual. You just need to email her your topic.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for filling me in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for filling me in.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thanks. That would’ve been easy to miss.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. That would’ve been easy to miss.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay, I’ll email her before Friday. Thanks!

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll email her before Friday. Thanks!
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
